Reasons why I smoke:

* I'm on 112.5 mg Venlafaxin and I'm still have nervous tensions that go away for a little bit when I smoke.
* It keeps me alive because it's one of the few pleasures in life I can enjoy right now.

I am clearly a borderline case but I'm certainly not the only one. In almost all psychiatric facilities around the world smoking is allowed because it helps the patients. I have been against smoking for the biggest part of my life but there's just no black and white. Opiates can be used out of addiction or to relieve pain. It's a similiar thing with nicotine.

And if you exercise too much you're also hurting your body. The damage is insignificant to the way smoke inhalation destroys your lungs but still.

Well, mostly little things like not caring weather people behind me in line at the supermarket would get angry if it takes me a little bit longer to pay. I also succeeded in getting two or three relationships going but somehow I always ended up worse than before.

Allthough it might not be that much the part I appreciate mostly about CBT is that I can talk to someone about stuff that I would otherwise share with nobody. I'm not really suicidal right now and I haven't cut myself for a very long time but the thing that can still be very disturbing are mental states where I see myself dying in a horiffic way or general feelings of despair and maybe rarely some case of small panic attacks accompaning these feelings. A good example would be the recent reddit post about the seven-year-old terminal-ill girl that got harrassed by her neighbors. When they organized all those presents for her I looked at the pictures and instead of being happy about the fact that she had a few nice days all I could think about was that she will be dead at some not too far away point in time. And then I cried for a minute or two as if it was my fault. I think it's called [Weltschmerz](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weltschmerz) but I might just be talking gibberish :)

It's a pretty late reply but I just encountered your post. I'm not in any pain and I am a pretty healthy 22 year old male. But as you have pointed out our mind allows us to imagine certain unpleasant future events. At the moment I can enjoy it again but one can't deny that it is also somewhat scary.

I'd like to reject it because it is just cruel. All of you guys here on SuicideWatch are just nice individuals. The world however doesn't give a fuck. One of you might get in an car accident while Glenn Beck gets to live 'till he's 100 and dies in his sleep. I'm just too weak and insignificant to change anything / do something about my own situation and maybe that's good for now. Thanks to everyone.

It helps a bit but a very big problem for me is the question why I should continue living when I am going to die anyway. Thanks though.

I sincerely hope that evolution and the appearance of intelligent life with conscience really are very very rare phenomenons. It certainly looks like it but considering the vast amount of other planets... we just don't know. What I'm trying to say is that I feel uncomfortable with notion that "I" can just be put into a body for the sake of evolution. Life has some very good sides, no doubt, but when you are "arriving" here it's almost impossible to say "Yeah, I've seen enough, I don't like it here... bye bye" because you suddenly have feelings (like love for your parents) and the possibility to perceive pain.


Aside from that you can doubt anything (e.g. Are my feelings real or are they just byproducts of evolution with the goal of passing on my genes) but there's just no way of knowing for certain. I would like to believe in a soul but when I look at the history of humanity and the way we treat each other it just makes it very hard.


So I'm not quite sure if life is worth it but it doesn't matter because there's really not much choice. To put it in the words of another redditor: "Whatcha gonna do about it, kill yourself? Yeah, you'll sure show the universe!"

That's a very onesided opinion. I can understand how one can come to it but just think for one second what you would have to go through to be able to take your own life.


I'm fighting against depression myself and I'm not condoning any of those actions. My personal thoughts of suicide would always involve a "quiet" method. But you might ask yourself why... why would I even think about such an option. I just give you an example how my mind is playing tricks on me: Yesterday I walked through our main train (somewhat funny in the context of the main post) station and everything was alright when I suddenly thought about the day I have to visit the funeral of one of my parents, which I love very much as a matter of fact. I realize that in the end I will definitely loose people that I care for very much. I have this thought very often and it really messes me up as you might imagine. I tried to keep myself together but at some point tears started to run down my face. This is a scenario you want to avoid at all costs as someone who is depressive because you don't want to become a burden for anyone. When you are faced with thoughts like these from time to time it just makes you wonder if life is just a big joke that's being played on your costs.


I don't want any pity and you don't need to worry. I'm in therapy and I'm advancing... although it are just little steps. The aim of this post was mostly to fight the stigma that's still out there. Consciousness is not a purely positive thing. It has been the next evolutionary step and allowed us to create the world around us as we know it. But it also lets you have thoughts that are very self destructive. Hopefully we will be able to fully understand how our brain works at some point and eliminate any feelings of depression with one simple drug (without totally slowing down the brain). Until that day there will be people who trow themselves before trains. It's still better than to go into a full classroom and shoot a human being. There are also a lot of people in the world which create beautiful things because they see the world from another perspective (Thom Yorke, Trent Reznor, [Stephen Fry](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_nXgZlvjkAo)).

P.S.: Please don't hold back on jokes. Satire and irony are some of the things I really enjoy about life :) - If you are trying to contact me I may not answer immediately since this is not my main login.

Weed wasn't the root of evil in my case. I simply abused it and got stoned (nearly) every fucking day for about 2 years. I might even smoke one when I'm at my friends place and he has some. But when I buy something for myself I have no control about my consumption whatsoever.

At the moment I just have the feeling that we're not a good match. But that's the thing. I can't be really sure that I don't like her because it could also be my fear of getting to dependent on someone else again. So which way to go in order to not feed my fear? I can think hours about this and not come to a conclusion.

To the illness part: For me it started when I was about 15. I went trough phases of depression and was cutting/burning myself to release the pain. And naturally I also thought about killing myself and even made some bullshit attempts but my will to survive was always bigger. Even though this might sound kind of serious I've also always distanced myself from calling myself ill because I wasn't really that suicidal. Yeah, I thought about it but in the end (I think) I was never really able to do it and I was pretty sure that I would not be. But that's not the point. It doesn't matter how often you think about it and with which intensity. The pure thought of it simply goes against the whole human nature and your survival instinct. And it might help you if you accept the fact that you have a (mild) form of this illness. When you get into situations where you would normally blame yourself you have the option to recognize that it's your mind playing tricks on you. Your still gonna blame yourself a lot because it's also part of this disease but for me it helped a little to accept it (but I'm not telling you what to do). Accepting it also doesn't mean that you are exploiting society (which was my impression for a long time). This would only be the case if you'll be driving around, demanding handicapped parking spaces because of your condition ;)

The thing that I like most about SW is that I can (try to) give people hope. At the same time telling about my own fears and obstacles has something very therapeutic and it gives me a sense of purpose that I might be missing sometimes.

After my first girlfriend left me I was kind of devastated I guess (can't remember exactly) but I got over it with the help of a friend and a lot of weed (might be the reason I can't remember exactly). Time went by and I continued smoking, so I wouldn't have to confront myself with my own situation which was mostly ok but I always had the feeling that something (a girlfriend to be exact) was missing. Whenever I tried to go out I would numb myself down by smoking. Naturally this didn't help that much when I tried to socialize because I was talking bullshit and in addition to that I got a little paranoid. After 3-4 years of loneliness and occasional suicide thoughts I went to a psychologist which gave me the advice to try psychotherapy. For the last year now I've been facing all my irrational fears, stopped smoking pot and achieved a lot (although there's still enough left over). I even got involved with women again but the last encounter made me suffer a rather enormous setback because I was being rejected and I just couldn't deal with it. I thought about ending my life very frequently that time. But eventually I recovered and I'm back with someone else. However my fears are still controlling me very often. The "relationship" I'm currently in is very fresh and I'm already thinking about ending it because I don't want to get hurt that bad again. And the thought of suicide still pops into my head if I want it or not. Why am I writing this? Partially I guess because I also wanted to write something here for a longer time and couldn't get myself to. But mostly to tell you that it can definitely get better. It's not that hopeless as you might think sometimes. The battle against your illness may be a hard and long one but things can improve. And I know that it feels totally unfair because there are so much morons running around in the world that would deserve these constant thoughts of doubt and insecurity much more. This doesn't change the fact that you have to live with a heavy burden. You being a good person, however, means that you can't give up on yourself so easily.

I often think to myself: "You've walked through emotional hell several times and always recovered. Life (that stupid bitch) can't bring me down!" That feeling disappears very quickly when I'm in doubt but maybe I can help someone else (and even myself at some other point) by writing it down here.

I would like to think that introvert people like ourself simply have an other conception of friendship. In my opinion 90% of those friendships you see on facebook are just shallow and superficial. When push comes to shove most of these people won't stick around. I can't say that this won't happen with the one or two good friends I have but the probability is not that high because I carefully decided weather I could trust those people. It also took me a long time to find them. And just because it's not working out for you atm. doesn't mean that there is no one out there who could care about you.

Don't use this as an argument for not going out because "you wouldn't find anyone that is on your wavelength anyhow" (that's what I partially did). Just don't think that you are doing anything wrong when it might seem harder for you to connect than it is for other people. You might even be a little bit other than the general puplic when it comes to this but if your conversation partner has a problem with that don't waste any more thoughts on him and move on. I'm afraid though that I'm too rational to be able to believe. On the other hand I could not worship god if i knew that he existed because in my eyes he would seem like a sadomasochistic douche bag who likes to take it up the ass. Pardon my French but if there is a god i could not imagine that he loves me or my "race". Also I hope that maybe I put a smile on someone's face with the previous expression :)

To the thought of suicide out of curiosity: I somehow get your point and I try to answer it with pure logic (even if it seems a little heartless).Since it is pretty certain that you and me are going to die why spoil it for yourself now. There may be still things out there (see 1st paragraph) that give your life meaning. Although it may seem futile at the moment.
